messages.dx.workshop.title: Darkforged Workshop
messages.dx.workshop.intro: Turn spare equipment into essences, then use essences to change item properties. Rune socketing and cube work also start here.
messages.dx.workshop.craftHint: Quest skills, materials and handmade recipes remain here. Crafting accepts normal bases; keep or salvage magic or better Darkforged gear.
messages.dx.workshop.legacy: This edition uses Darkforged affixes and essence enchanting. Native star upgrades, resets, potential and mixing are closed. Choose a Darkforged service below.
messages.dx.workshop.salvage.title: Salvage Equipment
messages.dx.workshop.salvage.intro: Turn unwanted magic, rare, set or legendary gear into matching essences. No cube or gold is needed.
messages.dx.workshop.enchant.title: Essence Enchanting
messages.dx.workshop.enchant.intro: Choose an essence, then an affix on gear in your bag.
messages.dx.workshop.enchant.cost: 1 matching essence + item level × {{gold}} gold; the first enchant permanently locks the slot, and only that slot can be rerolled.
messages.dx.workshop.enchant.empty: No essence; salvage spare gear at a blacksmith.
messages.dx.workshop.enchant.noTarget: No gear in your bag can use this essence.
messages.dx.workshop.socket.title: Rune Socketing
messages.dx.workshop.socket.intro: Choose a rune, then gear in your bag with an empty socket.
messages.dx.workshop.socket.order: Runes are permanent; runewords need a matching normal base, socket count and rune order.
messages.dx.workshop.socket.noTarget: No gear with empty sockets in your bag.
messages.dx.workshop.cube.title: Cube Work
messages.dx.workshop.cube.intro: Place the required gear and materials in the cube. Review the result and cost before confirming. Quest-material recipes remain available.
messages.dx.workshop.cube.reforge: Rare item + {{count}} rare essences: reroll all affixes.
messages.dx.workshop.cube.upgrade: Magic item + {{count}} rare essences: upgrade to rare.
messages.dx.workshop.cube.punch: Unsocketed normal item + {{count}} rare essences: open all sockets.
messages.dx.workshop.cube.rune: {{count}} identical runes: make 1 rune of the next tier.
messages.dx.workshop.error.legacy: Use essence enchanting or cube work for Darkforged gear. It cannot enter native star upgrades, mixing or gem enhancement.
messages.dx.workshop.error.recipeBase: Crafting accepts only normal bases. Keep or salvage magic or better Darkforged gear first.
